verdict.rationale: Carta documents capitalization-table, stakeholder, option-grant, convertible-note and FMV endpoints. The client-credentials OAuth flow gives a company access to its own data without interactive consent, and an official Claude MCP cap-table plugin lets an agent query ownership, SAFEs, convertibles and financing history in natural language, so the programmatic cap-table pull is clearly delivered. Reconciling against a data room is left to the agent, with no Carta-side support documented. missing for 10: any documented data-room integration or reconciliation workflow, stable non-alpha endpoints (current endpoints are v1alpha1), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agent cap-table pulls.
